d:
IPL nilami men tahalka machane aur bharat ki andar-19 tim men shandar pradarshan karne vale samastipur (bihar) ke yuva sanasni kriketar vaibhav suryavanshi (Vaibhav Suryavanshi) ko bara inam mila hai. bihar kriket esosieshan (BCA) ne unhen bihar ki siniyar kriket tim ka kaptan niyukt kiya hai.
Apni tabartor ballebaji aur paripakv khel shaili se kriket diggajon ko prabhavit karne vale vaibhav suryavanshi ab gharelu kriket men bihar siniyar tim ki kaman sanbhalte najar aaenge. itni kam umr men siniyar tim ki kaptani milna bhartiy kriket itihas ke sabse durlabh aur aitihasik palon men se ek hai.
